rows.en: Miss Relena wishes to give a speech calling for peace<pt(0,-13,0,2)> to the entire Earth Sphere.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: We will seize the UCE <pic(0)><cs(3)>Parliament building<ce()> by force and back Miss Relena's speech.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: To reach as many people as possible, we plan to broadcast it to the entire Earth Sphere.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: Naturally, though, I doubt Dermail will just sit back and watch.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: We<mk(0,12.5,4,0)><mk(-50,-12.5,6,3,100)><mk(50,-12.5,2,3,50)><mk(0,-37.5,0,3,100)> will deploy <pic(1)><cs(3)>around the city<ce()> and guard the Parliament building.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: Our aim now is to show people the need for peace. I want you to avoid combat if you can.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: Thanks to all of you, I was able to make my will known. I am truly grateful.
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: Your presence is a great source of encouragement to me, and it gives me courage.
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: And so there is just one more request I would like you to hear.
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: I would like you to take me to Jaburo.
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: By placing myself in the UCE's hands and negotiating with them directly,
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: I intend to propose that the E2, which threatens peace, be disposed of.
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: I know this is dangerous for you, since you have left the UCE, but
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: I do not want the feelings of the people who answered my call to go to waste.
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft

rows.en: Will the day ever come when an age of peace arrives...
rows.speaker: Relena Peacecraft?
